newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Nutreco share price set at Dfl 37.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Nutreco share price set at Dfl 37.

text.p: The offer price of shares in Dutch animal and fish feeds group Nutreco has been set at 37 guilders each, the top of the initial price range, the lead managers and global co-ordinators said on Monday.
Goldman Sachs International and Rabo Securities said the final number of shares on offer was set at 15.126 million.
"As a result of substantial demand from retail investors, it was decided to close the subscription period for retail investors on May 26, 1997," they said in a statement.
About one third of the shares offered went to retail investors.
Trading in Nutreco shares will begin on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange on Tuesday. The initial price range for the shares had been indicated at 33 to 37 guilders.

Nutreco has said the offering will allow it to expand its shareholder base and secure access to capital markets to finance growth, while the listing would provide a liquid market for Nutreco shareholders.
